description: Prince George District Road Alerts is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by Regional Operations - Omineca. A visual representation of road closures and alerts in the Prince George Natural Resouce District. This data is used in the Prince George Road Alerts web map application. A description of the application can be found in the following metadata record: Prince George Road Alerts. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher Regional Operations - Omineca. Its tags are resource road closure alert. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-03 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Access Only. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
